review.method: Visual review of the 0.5-second labeled contact sheet, adjacent indexed frames around each declared transition, and scene-detection candidates; motion-only peaks were rejected as cuts.
review.boundaryConvention: Each start is the first reference frame assigned to the next visual segment. Black runs and title cards are separate segments. A dissolve or graphic fade is placed at the first visibly changed frame used in this review.
review.scope: This is a reviewed segmentation for this Sintel trailer and these source/reference hashes. It is not a general scene detector ground-truth set or a blind model-quality verdict.

boundaries.event: Interior scene fades in after the title card.
Cut to dragon and sky view.
Dragon close shot begins after a black frame.
Cross-dissolve into desert landscape becomes visible.
Sintel logo first appears over the landscape.
Landscape fades out beneath the logo.
